sentence: This project provides gene editing, genotyping and mouse colony services to scientists who work with mouse models.
This project tests whether extracellular vesicles can deliver gene editing tools to their tissue of origin in mice, as a contraceptive.
This project uses machine learning on clinical data to build models of severe pneumonia and find biomarkers.
This project tries to find out which cell types in the brain and body are affected when aging changes circadian clocks.
This project studies how mutations in a gene that encodes an RNA splicing factor change hematopoietic stem cells and lead to myelodysplastic syndromes.
This project builds a platform that measures behavior while people make decisions that take physical effort, including people with treatment-resistant depression.
This project provides mouse strains and genetically engineered mouse models to help test candidate genes involved in addiction.
This project develops a way to use CRISPR to raise the chance that a mouse inherits a desired combination of alleles.
This project develops an imaging technique to look at deep tissue, to better understand organ functions and disease progression.
This project builds a platform to find unidentified gut microbial ene-reductases and learn about their genetic basis and effects on microbes and their host.
This project uses whole genome sequencing and genome editing to study how human mutations contribute to disease.
This project studies how xylazine, alone and with opioids, affects neural function and synaptic plasticity in the prefrontal cortex.
This project builds a microscope with many cameras and software to take live 3D images of tumor organoids in well plates.
This project develops MRI methods to image the skull base and face with shorter scan times.
This project looks for kinase inhibitors that could treat both giardiasis and cryptosporidiosis, two intestinal parasitic diseases.
This project studies how gene mutations and maternal use of antidepressant drugs together lead to craniosynostosis.
This project develops gene therapy using adeno-associated virus vectors to treat kidney stone disease caused by cystinuria, testing it in a mouse model.
This project provides light microscopy and image analysis services to investigators who study diabetes.
This project builds machine-learning tools that use mass spectrometry data to measure known and unknown small molecules in biological samples.
